name: Ephemeral LLM session lease
purpose: Reuse the existing StegBrowser lease and runtime owner for one source invocation. Do not reuse historical A3 admission for a new invocation.
trigger: an existing canonical task selects this reusable scenario in its invocation manifest
scope: one manifest-bound invocation under existing ownership
reuse_instructions: Materialize with scripts/compose_ecosystem_chat_task.py and the existing reusable-task constructor. These are definitions, not an executable runner or admission. Existing StegBrowser / StegOS / WorkerCoordinator / InTr / TV-TVC / organization ledger / Master Records own execution and evidence. The existing trigger stops at NO_EXECUTABLE_RUNNER_DECLARED until an existing owner binds its authentic entrypoint. No second runtime or synthetic receipt.
